import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    p = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    num = 1

    if k <= 1:
        # multiply by p exactly (p - 1 + k) times
        for _ in range(p - 1 + k):
            num = (num * p) % MOD
    else:
        used = [False] * p
        for i in range(1, p):
            if not used[i]:
                num = (num * p) % MOD
                used[i] = True
                q = (i * k) % p
                while q != i:
                    used[q] = True
                    q = (q * k) % p
    print(num)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
